procedure details the outlines steps required for the major maintenance

An outage is always required to complete the work.

items:
A work permit must be issued, 
the qualified maintenance staff should
 carry the suitable safety category,

Safety rope with caution 
marks surrounding the work area,
Wear your safety helmet, shoes .... etc
Circuit breaker must be isolated and properly earthed.
Isolate the DC control voltage.

Before using a blower to clean all compartments of 
 the circuit breaker from dust,
 wear your breathing mask to protect your lung
tissues from the dust particulate.

Don't bum the cloth used in cleaning, collect it
and send it to the dump.

Fix any oil leaks from connections, safety valve,
bleeding washers, and motion transmission shaft to prevent pollution and save
money of wasted oil.

Oil leaks to the ground have very bad impacts on
the environment, mainly on soil and ground water and eventually on the
ecosystem, "It takes only I liter of Hydrocarbon spilled in an aquifer to
render 1,000,000 liters of potable water useless for human consumption".

SF6 leaks also have bad impacts on the
environment.
